introduction.zh: 你更想欢迎新朋友、一起做熟悉的小事、玩个小游戏、看看新消息、保留个人趣味、慢慢加入，还是轻松待一会？21道原创题比较普通相处中的自选偏好，七份完整说明可先读，最高并列全部完整显示。选用七位三丽鸥角色，不代表全阵容，也不按外貌、性别或心理疾病分型。
introduction.en: Would you rather welcome someone new, share a familiar activity, play, notice an update, keep a personal twist, join gradually or take it easy? Twenty-one original questions compare everyday chosen preferences. Read all seven guides first and see every highest tie in full. Seven selected Sanrio characters represent neither the entire cast nor categories of appearance, gender or mental illness.

instructions.zh: 21道原创非官方同人题，用凯蒂猫、美乐蒂、大眼蛙、巧克猫、酷企鹅、大耳狗和布丁狗七位角色比较普通相处中的自选偏好。每题从四种做法选一个较接近自己的；都以自愿、许可和可停止为前提。每选加1，每位出现12次、每位置3次，总数21，最高并列全部完整显示。无需买周边、看动画或提供照片；不测外貌、善良程度、能力或心理疾病，不是三丽鸥官方测试，也不把角色换算成MBTI。
instructions.en: Twenty-one original unofficial fan questions compare voluntary everyday preferences through seven selected Sanrio characters: Hello Kitty, My Melody, Keroppi, Chococat, Badtz-Maru, Cinnamoroll and Pompompurin. Choose the closer of four approaches in permitted, voluntary situations that can end. Each choice adds one; each character appears twelve times, three per position, and counts sum to twenty-one. Every highest tie appears in full. No merchandise, animation knowledge or photo is needed. This is no official Sanrio test or measure of appearance, goodness, ability or mental illness, and characters do not convert into MBTI types.

description.en: Read your Hello Kitty result through welcoming a newcomer: a craft example, wording, six comparisons and scoring in an unofficial full guide.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 三丽鸥官方简介里的凯蒂猫喜欢结识朋友。本站借这个背景，选择“为新朋友留个位置”的角度：先发出清楚、可拒绝的邀请，再让对方决定怎么参加。这是本版对普通相处的有限读法，不是官方人格分类。你无需一直热情、擅长聊天或认识许多人，安静的一次欢迎也能符合这个角度。
paragraphs.en: Sanrio’s short biography connects Hello Kitty with making friends. This edition uses that background for an opening that somebody new may accept or decline. The emphasis is making participation available rather than producing an impressive introduction. A quiet welcome can fit just as well as an animated greeting. This is one editorial fan reading, with no requirement to be consistently outgoing, talkative or surrounded by acquaintances.

title.en: Which choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些题目里较常选到欢迎新面孔、给新来的人留空间的做法。想想当时吸引你的是认识人，还是希望聚会容易加入：两者可以不同。问卷没有实际观察社交行为，也不评朋友多少。你依然可以只想与熟人相处，或者今天不想加入任何活动；这不会推翻一次选择记录。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records more selections involving a newcomer or an opening to join. Was the appeal meeting somebody, making the setting accessible, or simply knowing how an invitation works? These can be different reasons for the same answer. No social behaviour was observed and no friend count was collected. Wanting familiar company or time alone on another day is compatible with this particular set of choices.

title.en: A concrete everyday example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，朋友带来一个你不认识的人参加纸卡小聚，你可以说这里还有空位，也可以先问对方想看还是想做。不必要求立刻自我介绍、跟着同一套玩法或展示作品。若对方选择旁观，邀请就已经完成；你也能回到自己的卡片。让入口清楚与承担整场气氛是两件事，不需要每次都负责照顾所有人。
paragraphs.en: At a card-making afternoon, point out an available place and ask whether the new person would like to watch or make something. They need not introduce themselves immediately, follow the same method or show a finished card. Watching can be the complete response to your invitation. Return to your own project afterwards. Offering an opening and becoming responsible for the whole gathering are separate choices, with quite different demands.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 一句表达可以是：“这里还有位置，你想一起做、先看看，或者不参加都可以。”有共同安排时，再确认现有参与者是否方便，不替别人许诺时间或材料。你也可以说自己今天只待一会；明确自己的余地不会让欢迎失效。好的邀请容得下拒绝、短暂停留与不同参与方式，不需要用更多热情换取回应。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “There is a place here if you want to make something or just watch; passing is fine too.” Check shared space and materials before offering what belongs to others. Mention your own limited time if needed. An invitation can remain warm with an endpoint, a refusal or different forms of participation. Its usefulness does not depend on receiving enthusiasm in return or keeping conversation going indefinitely.

title.zh: 与其他六角色读法比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other six readings

paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂猫读法重在新朋友的加入，美乐蒂重在熟悉小事中的陪伴，大眼蛙重在一起玩；三者都可能很友好。巧克猫留意新消息，酷企鹅保留个人趣味，大耳狗慢慢加入，布丁狗让相处从容。欢迎一个人不代表必须带头玩、提供新点子或消除安静。并列说明这些选项同样常见，不把谁排成更受欢迎、更可爱或更善良。
paragraphs.en: Hello Kitty concerns an opening for somebody new, My Melody familiar shared activity and Keroppi shared play. All three can be friendly. Chococat notices updates, Badtz-Maru keeps personal playfulness, Cinnamoroll joins gradually and Pompompurin leaves unhurried room. Welcoming someone need not supply a game, news or constant conversation. Equal counts retain several readings without ranking popularity, attractiveness or goodness, and none establishes how other people actually feel about you.

title.en: Counterexamples and interpretation limits

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，邀请新人可能因为你熟悉场地，并非平时喜欢广交朋友；先旁观的人也可以非常重视别人。结果不能判断外向程度、孤独、讨好、社交能力或关系质量。若你根本不喜欢被安排欢迎别人，就把这个差异记下来，不必为了像某个角色而接受额外责任。卡通人物的亲切形象也不意味着现实里必须随时可接近。

Conversation can emerge while doing something simple, without requiring a new attraction or a polished outcome. Baking, particular food, caregiving, pink clothing and any gendered expectation are unnecessary. The reading concerns an ordinary activity you choose to share, rather than an official account of your personality.

title.en: Which choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择和熟悉同伴重复喜欢的小活动，重视一起做的过程。可以问自己：熟悉让你更舒服，还是今天只想节省准备时间？这不是依赖、念旧或拒绝变化的分数。你可以独自做同一件事，也可以下一次主动尝新；不同场合改变安排很自然，不需要长期维持某种角色气质。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means familiar shared activities appeared relatively often among your choices. Familiarity might feel pleasant, reduce preparation or simply suit this occasion. The count does not distinguish those reasons and measures no dependence, nostalgia or resistance to change. You can do the same activity alone or choose something unfamiliar next time. There is no obligation to preserve a consistently gentle, traditional or companion-oriented image across changing situations.

title.en: A concrete everyday example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，和熟悉朋友用已有纸片做书签，可以沿用上次的简单折法，边做边聊，也可以各做各的。开始前确认两个人都愿意重复，而非因为你喜欢就默认对方也喜欢。若朋友想换一种方式，你们可以分开做，再彼此看看。共同过程不要求同款作品、全程交谈或不停帮助；安静并坐也可以是相聚的一种样子。

A shared process needs neither matching objects nor continuous conversation or assistance. Sitting alongside one another can be enough, without turning the afternoon into a demonstration of closeness.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我还想做上次那件小东西，你愿意一起吗？你想换个做法也行。”把共同参与与作品要求分开，别人不参加也不代表拒绝这段关系。自己只想做一会时，同样可以说清楚。熟悉的小事只是一个方便的相处入口，不负责维持亲密、解决冲突或让所有人开心，也无需把对方的需求排在自己之前。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I would enjoy making that little thing again. Would you like to join, perhaps with a different approach?” Separate companionship from the product and its rules. Declining the activity need not reject the relationship, and a short shared interval can have a clear endpoint. Familiar activity offers an opening for time together without maintaining intimacy, resolving disagreement or making everybody happy, and your own preferences still deserve a place.

title.en: Comparisons with the other six readings

paragraphs.en: My Melody emphasises a familiar process, Hello Kitty an opening for new company and Keroppi shared play. Familiar activities can include either. Chococat notices news, Badtz-Maru personal playfulness, Cinnamoroll pace of joining and Pompompurin unhurried time. These angles divide no traditional or innovative people and nominate no caregivers. Read tied guides together or compare a close guide by choice; no single character needs to explain the whole experience of spending time with others.

Familiarity does not establish suitability, and an uncomfortable arrangement needs attention on its actual terms. A My Melody reading is no instruction to yield or remain gentle under pressure. You can decline or change your mind without providing a compensating performance for somebody else.

description.en: Read your Keroppi result through optional doodle play, simple rules, six comparisons, counterexamples and scoring. No sporting or competition score.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 三丽鸥的官方简介把大眼蛙与朋友、游戏联系起来。本版选“把相聚变成一起玩”的角度，用普通纸笔、轻松轮流等情境讨论共同乐趣，不测运动能力或反应速度。角色住在池塘等背景帮助辨认身份，不表示你有相同生活方式，也不要求参加户外项目、比赛或扮演聚会气氛担当。
paragraphs.en: Official context associates Keroppi with friends and games. This edition selects shared play, using ordinary paper, simple turns and willing participants rather than sporting performance. Setting details identify the fictional character without assigning you a lifestyle. There is no need to organise an outing, compete, perform quickly or become the person who keeps a gathering lively. Play can be quiet, brief and unrelated to winning or producing anything valuable.

title.en: Which choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择给相聚加一点共同玩法。可以问：你喜欢的是轮流互动、没有成品要求，还是大家一起经历同一件小事？计数不区分这些原因，也不记录游戏水平。你能只提议一次，别人不想玩时就停下；不必因为得到大眼蛙结果而总有点子、总有精力，或负责让别人尽兴。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you often selected a little play within shared time. Taking turns, avoiding a finished-product requirement and experiencing the same small event can each explain the appeal. Counts cannot separate those reasons or record game skill. Offer something once and stop if others prefer not to play. Receiving Keroppi requires no permanent supply of ideas, energy or responsibility for making everyone enjoy themselves throughout an afternoon.

title.en: A concrete everyday example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，用普通纸笔接着画一条线，每个人愿意才加一笔，没有画得好坏或输赢的要求。先说清可以跳过、旁观或随时结束，也不拿别人的作品开玩笑。最后纸上可能没有完整图案，大家也可以已经玩够。这个例子把共同过程放在前面，不以兴奋程度、参与人数或持续时长判断是否成功，更不要求所有人保持同样步调。
paragraphs.en: For example, invite people to add a line to a shared doodle if they wish, without judging drawing quality or declaring winners. Allow passing, watching and ending, and avoid making someone’s contribution a joke. The page may never become a complete picture. The shared interval can still have served its purpose, without a success score based on excitement, group size or duration, or a demand that everyone participate at the same pace.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“愿意的话轮流加一笔，不想画可以跳过，玩一会就停。”若自己更想休息，也直接说今天不发起。邀请游戏不是取得他人时间的许可，轻松气氛也不能替代实际同意；听到“不玩”就结束邀请即可。你可以享受游戏，同时不喜欢竞争、被起哄或公开展示，这些选择不矛盾，也不需要角色结果替你解释。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “Add a line in turn if you like; passing is fine, and we can stop after a little while.” You can also want rest and propose nothing today. A playful atmosphere gives no claim on another person’s time. Accept a refusal without turning it into another game. Enjoying play while disliking competition, teasing or public performance is entirely possible and needs no fictional explanation or consistent character identity.

title.en: Comparisons with the other six readings

paragraphs.zh: 大眼蛙读法偏一起玩，凯蒂猫偏让新人加入，美乐蒂偏熟悉活动；一个小游戏可能同时包含三者。巧克猫偏发现新变化，酷企鹅偏个人趣味，大耳狗偏慢慢加入，布丁狗偏舒服从容。喜欢新规则与喜欢一起玩也不是同一件事。最高并列保留不同切面，不代表你比别人更活泼、乐观、健康或有团队精神。

Chococat notices variations, Badtz-Maru personal playfulness, Cinnamoroll gradual participation and Pompompurin comfortable time. Enjoying a new rule and enjoying playing together are distinct preferences. paragraphs.en: Selecting a game may simply suit a wait on this occasion, while quiet conversation remains your usual preference. Declining play can still value shared experience. This reading infers no hyperactivity, impulse, social skill, fitness, leadership or suitable occupation. Actual space, time and willingness determine an activity’s fit. Cancel an uncomfortable game without proving that you are entertaining or treating refusal and discomfort as obstacles a Keroppi-like person must overcome to make the event succeed.

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, imagine a tiny activity without winners for an ordinary setting you already want to join. Include watching and an endpoint, with no need to try it. Notice whether turns, shared attention or freedom from a finished product matters. You may discover that conversation appeals more. Distinguish the particular pleasure of play without training teamwork, increasing physical activity or attempting to become more popular with a group of friends.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

This edition selects noticing an update, without transferring fictional senses or claiming attention, tidiness or organisational ability. One small difference can interest you without making you the person with the most information or the fastest updates. The character provides context for an ordinary preference, rather than evidence of an actual human capability.

title.en: Which choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，你在这些题里较常选择查看新消息、发现以前没注意的细节。可以问自己：新鲜本身吸引你，还是某个变化恰好与这次活动有关？问卷不追踪你看过什么，也不测记忆准确度。知道有变化与了解变化含义是两步，你依然可以说还没看懂、暂时不关注或今天不想接收更多信息。
paragraphs.en: A highest count records frequent choices involving updates or unnoticed details. Novelty itself may appeal, or the change may matter for this particular activity. No browsing history was collected and no memory accuracy was measured. Noticing that something changed and understanding what the change means are separate steps. You can remain unsure, decline further information or choose not to follow a topic without contradicting the answers you selected in this brief quiz.

title.en: A concrete everyday example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，朋友更新了普通纸上活动的时间，你先发现“比原先晚半小时”，再看看自己是否仍方便。不必立即把整个安排转发给所有人；若只是私人消息，先确认是否适合分享。这个例子把变化和它的实际影响分开，不以知道更多、抢先发布或反应更快认证聪明。没有新消息时，保留原安排也很合理。
paragraphs.en: A friend changes the time of a casual paper activity. You notice it is half an hour later and then consider whether that still suits you. Forwarding the entire arrangement to everybody is unnecessary; private information may not be yours to share. This example separates an update from its practical implications. Knowing more, publishing first and responding fastest certify no intelligence, while an unchanged arrangement can remain perfectly adequate when no update is relevant.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我看到这一处变了，先确认一下是不是最新安排；你需要我把这一点说清吗？”把看到、理解和确认区分开，不确定时直接说明。消息不一定需要你解释，更不要求替别人搜集私人情况。你可以喜欢新发现，同时选择减少通知或慢一点回复；可用时间与兴趣都能变化，不必维持“随时知道”的角色。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I noticed this changed; I will check whether it is current. Would a brief explanation help?” Distinguish seeing, understanding and confirming, and name uncertainty directly. Not every update needs your explanation, and collecting private information about someone else is unnecessary. Interest in discoveries can coexist with fewer notifications or slower replies. Available time and interest may change without maintaining an always-informed role for friends or a group.

paragraphs.en: Chococat concerns updates and My Melody familiar process, rather than intelligence versus conservatism. Keroppi emphasises shared play, Badtz-Maru personal playfulness, Hello Kitty new participation, Cinnamoroll joining pace and Pompompurin unhurried time. A new game can interest both Chococat and Keroppi readings: one notices the variation, the other the shared play. Equal counts retain several angles without ranking knowledge, curiosity or responsiveness, and neither angle determines the value of the activity itself.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，发现新时间可能只是你需要赶车，并非喜欢追消息；没注意一处变化也不说明粗心。结果不判断注意缺陷、记忆、焦虑、八卦、学习能力或工作适配。真实消息是否可靠需要看来源与语境，问卷不替任何信息背书。遇到不想了解的私人话题，可以不问、不看、不转述；角色的虚构触须不是现实里窥探他人的理由。
paragraphs.en: Noticing a changed time may follow a transport constraint rather than a taste for news. Missing a detail does not establish carelessness. Counts assess no attention condition, memory, anxiety, gossip, learning ability or occupational fit. Actual information needs its own source and context checks; this quiz endorses none of it. You can avoid asking, viewing or repeating unwanted private material. A fictional whisker ability provides no reason to inspect someone else’s life or belongings.

title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：从自己愿意看的普通安排里找一处已知变化，分开写“我看到什么”“还没确认什么”“是否影响我”，不需要找新消息或查别人。如果没有变化，也写没有。观察重点是把新信息与解释分开，而非提高警觉、练记忆或随时保持在线。你也可以选择暂停接收，等真正需要时再看。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, take one known update in an ordinary arrangement you already want to view. Separate what you saw, what remains unconfirmed and whether it affects you, without seeking news or investigating anybody. Record no change if there is none. Notice the difference between information and interpretation without training vigilance, memory or constant availability. Pausing updates until they are actually useful remains an equally reasonable choice for your time and attention.

description.en: Read a Badtz-Maru result through a playful bookmark detail, wording, six comparisons and scoring. Difference is no label of rebellion or difficulty.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 官方短简介呈现酷企鹅带点淘气与自己视角的角色背景。本版取“保留自己的趣味”这一角度，放在自有纸张、私人书签等普通情境里，不鼓励恶作剧或嘲讽别人。角色的表情与造型帮助辨认身份，不是答题者脾气的证据；你可以喜欢一点特别的设计，也可以在很多事上与别人相同。
paragraphs.en: Official context gives Badtz-Maru a mischievous perspective. This edition selects personal playfulness within ordinary choices about your own paper or bookmark, without encouraging pranks or ridicule. A fictional expression and design identify the character rather than proving your temperament. Enjoying one unusual detail can coexist with sharing many preferences with other people. The reading offers a small angle on chosen enjoyment, without requiring a permanently unconventional appearance, attitude or way of interacting with friends.

title.en: Which choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择给自己的版本留一点独特趣味。可以问：你真喜欢这个细节，还是只因为别人都用了另一种样式？计数不辨别，也不判断原创能力。自己的趣味可以很普通，不必与众不同才算成立；已经和别人一样时，也不用刻意改变，更不需要借一次问卷证明独立或坚持某种形象。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you often chose a personally playful detail for your own version. Does the detail appeal in itself, or mainly because others chose something else? Counts cannot decide and assess no originality. Your taste may be common and still belong to you. Matching other people does not require a corrective change, and this quiz offers no reason to prove independence by maintaining a distinctive image or disagreeing with an otherwise suitable arrangement.

title.en: A concrete everyday example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，大家各做自己的书签，你想在自己那张留一个奇怪的小角或不对称图形，可以先看看是否仍好用。别人不需要照做，也不必理解同一个笑点；如果后来不喜欢，换回简单样式即可。个人趣味在这里是自己作品的一部分，不是点评别人的机会，不以得到注意、引发争论或别人觉得大胆来认证。
paragraphs.en: When everyone makes a personal bookmark, you might choose an odd corner or an asymmetric shape on yours and check that it remains usable. Nobody needs to copy it or share the same amusement. Return to a simple version if preferred later. Personal playfulness belongs to your object here, without inviting commentary on someone else’s work. Attention, argument and being called daring are unnecessary measures of whether the detail is worth keeping for yourself.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，与朋友约一个不必完成作品的下午，可以各带一件愿意做的小事，想聊就聊，想停就停。提前说清大致结束时间，不因为“轻松”就让别人无限等候。舒服也需要各自确认，同一张椅子或同一音量不一定适合所有人。这个例子重在有余地的安排，不以待得更久、吃了什么或睡得怎样衡量休闲质量。
paragraphs.en: For an afternoon needing no finished object, bring a small chosen activity, talk if wanted and pause freely. Agree an approximate endpoint rather than making someone wait indefinitely in the name of relaxation. Check comfort individually: the same seat or volume need not suit everyone. The example concerns room within an arrangement, without judging leisure quality through duration, food or sleep. A short interval can be enough, with different activities continuing independently if that suits the participants.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“今天想轻松待一会，不把时间排满；到这个点我就结束。”若别人更想玩游戏或完成作品，可以各做各的，也可以另约时间。不需要用“随便”隐藏自己的不愿意；具体说清舒服和不舒服之处，通常比要求大家都放松更准确。你也可以有不同意见，从容不等于凡事配合、没有边界或永远不生气。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I would like an easy interval without filling it, and I will finish at this time.” Someone else may want a game or a completed project; choose separate activities or another occasion. “Anything is fine” need not conceal a refusal. Describe what suits you rather than asking everyone to relax. Unhurried time allows disagreement and boundaries, without requiring permanent cooperation, a lack of preferences or a consistently cheerful emotional state throughout the day.

title.en: Comparisons with the other six readings

paragraphs.zh: 布丁狗读法偏从容，大耳狗偏加入的速度；熟悉场地的人也可能想休息，慢慢加入的人也可能很快投入。美乐蒂偏熟悉活动，凯蒂猫偏新朋友，大眼蛙偏共享玩法，巧克猫偏新变化，酷企鹅偏个人趣味。一个轻松下午可以容纳所有这些角度。最高并列不是混合体质、能量类型或休息需求，不给任何偏好排高低。
paragraphs.en: Pompompurin concerns unhurried room and Cinnamoroll joining pace. Someone familiar with a setting may want a pause, while a gradual arrival may later become absorbed. My Melody concerns familiar activity, Hello Kitty new company, Keroppi play, Chococat updates and Badtz-Maru personal playfulness. An easy afternoon can contain all these angles. paragraphs.en: Choosing a comfortable place may follow the available space rather than a preference for slow time. A structured schedule can also feel easy. This reading assesses no sleep, diet, health, emotional disorder, laziness, productivity or accommodation in relationships. Understand any continuing concern on its actual terms rather than through a fictional character’s lifestyle. There is no need to demonstrate successful relaxation or turn the number of completed activities into a score for this particular period of companionship.

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, take an interval of free time you already want to keep. Name one possible activity, an empty space and an endpoint, with no need to carry it out.
